articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock Price Slides As Q4 Earnings Expose Margin Squeeze
articles.description: QUALCOMM came into this Q4 2026 report with the stock already drifting lower over the past month. The real shock landed after the numbers hit, with the share price dropping about 9% to around US$156 in the first full session after earnings. What sparked that kind of reaction was not collapsing sales. Quarterly revenue printed at roughly US$10.3b, while basic earnings per share of about US$1.18 pointed to a clear profit squeeze versus the prior quarter. For a chip giant long sold on a premium...
